objective: Make BUKLOD Lesson and mentoring-release checking non-punitive with unlimited guided revisions, and make all published content-ready BUKLOD lesson options available in the authorized mentor teaching report selector.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main source head ecd34228dd24f07a47ba397bb1c29199aac51779 read on 2026-11-22 before the isolated DEV branch was created; no installed production APK/OTA runtime fingerprint was asserted or changed.
chosenApproach: Keep authoritative server evaluation and reward guards; surface feedback for all fields, never display a permanent lesson failure, keep editable retries; remove client 20-item catalog truncation; broaden only the authorized SQL catalog to published content-ready learning_tracks.
selectionRationale: The source limited visible mentor options to twenty, the catalog to CCP/discipleship, and review checking returned after its first imperfect answer. Backend completion and learning verification must not be bypassed.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Update only the lesson review presentation and mentoring lesson picker without modifying app navigation, ads, authentication or verified earning authority.
preservedBehaviors: All lesson responses remain subject to server verification and a durable response receipt; no points are deducted for a retry and none are invented for an unapproved lesson.
Mentor teaching reports still require an explicitly authorized mentor, active assigned learners, an idempotent session key, private consented photo evidence and System Admin review.
No native modules, navigation layout, pricing, AdMob placements or APK runtime are changed.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Broaden mentor-visible published BUKLOD lesson titles while retaining mandatory server-side mentor authorization and least-privilege function execution ACL.
preservedBehaviors: Unauthorized callers and ordinary members cannot gain mentor capabilities or record rewarded mentoring sessions by changing client search terms.
Only published and content-ready canonical learning lessons appear, and photo evidence and verified-assignment gates remain server-authoritative.
No historical approvals, RLS policies, existing BP ledger, QMP, review records or private storage objects are mutated by this migration.

preserveBehaviors: No permanent fail grade: imperfect answers remain editable with unlimited attempts, but verified approval remains necessary for completion and rewards.
No automatic role or reward grants and no exposure of unpublished/unfinished curriculum.
No direct change to production database, Play build, OTA or external deployment.
The user's photo permission, assigned learners and System Admin review cannot be bypassed.
acceptanceChecks: Run focused Node contract tests on exact branch SHA plus prior mentor selector/reward tests.
Run source, engineering accountability and protected-feature anti-regression gates.

Apply and RLS-test SQL only on an isolated nonproduction PostgreSQL test environment, verifying an unauthenticated and ordinary member receives no catalog, and a permitted mentor can select all published ready lessons.

Verify real Android weak-network lesson completion, editing, retry, refresh, catalog search/scroll, photo consent, mentor record idempotency and unrelated Ads/navigation/spacing gates before any consolidated RC.
Keep production unchanged until verified consolidated release.
